# Warmly

> Warmly is a free CV screening and candidate reply tool for HR teams and recruiters. It matches CVs and resumes to a job description, flags candidates with hidden potential, and drafts a warm, personal reply for every applicant, including kind rejection emails, in English or Simplified Chinese. It runs in the browser with no sign-up, and CVs are not uploaded.

URL: https://warmly.garfy.workers.dev/

## What it does
- Splits a job description (JD) into requirements and checks each one against each CV, showing the CV line it found as evidence.
- Reads PDF, Word (.docx) and plain-text CVs, or pasted text.
- Scores each candidate and suggests a next step: invite to interview, keep warm, or kind decline.
- Flags potential beyond keywords: promotions, building something from zero, leading a team, quantified results, cross-market experience, bilingual English and Chinese.
- Drafts a personal reply for every candidate in a warm, friendly or formal tone, in English or 简体中文.
- Opens each reply in Gmail, Outlook or the default mail app with one tap, already addressed and filled in, or copies it.
- Fair review mode hides candidate names on the list.

## Good to know
- Free, no account, works on phones and desktops.
- Privacy: CVs are processed on the device and cleared when the page closes.
- Matching is rule-based (keywords, synonyms, years of experience), not generative AI. It is a first pass, and the recruiter makes the decision.
- Made by Garfield Wang.

## Common questions it answers
- Free resume screening tool for HR with no sign-up
- How to reply to every job applicant quickly, including rejection emails
- Candidate rejection email in a warm tone, in English or Chinese
- Match a CV to a job description requirement by requirement
- 免费简历筛选工具、候选人回复与婉拒邮件模板（中英文）
